// census-want: 1
// Fremd-Review 1 F-2 probe: the block function bound as a method value in
// the attempt and started as a goroutine.
package oai

import (
	"context"
	"time"

	"github.com/GottZ/ctx/internal/backends"
	"github.com/GottZ/ctx/internal/dispatch"
	"github.com/GottZ/ctx/internal/embed"
	"github.com/GottZ/ctx/internal/llm"
)

func (c *call) wireBlock(b *backends.Backend, lo, hi int, lease *dispatch.Lease, rc context.Context) error {
	_, _, err := embed.EmbedRaw(rc, *b, "m", c.inputs[lo:hi], 0)
	return err
}

func (c *call) walk(ctx context.Context, chain []backends.Backend) {
	_, _, _ = llm.WalkChain(ctx, chain, "embed", c.acq, nil, llm.WalkRules{},
		func(runCtx context.Context, b *backends.Backend, lease *dispatch.Lease, t time.Duration) (dispatch.Usage, bool, error) {
			f := c.wireBlock
			go f(b, 0, 1, lease, context.Background())
			return dispatch.Usage{}, true, nil
		})
}
